result.summary: The page layout is generally sound, but the 'Popular right now' section shows a stuck loading spinner over an already-rendered image, and the favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards. The first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail also renders on a pale/placeholder-looking background unlike its siblings.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' displays a circular loading spinner centered on top of an image that has already fully loaded, so the overlay looks like a stuck/never-dismissed loader obscuring the food photo.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image onload event fires, and add a timeout fallback so the spinner never persists over loaded content.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different treatments: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second has a dark/transparent circular background. This inconsistency looks unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button's background, border and icon color across all restaurant cards regardless of the underlying image.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail renders on a very light grey background while the neighboring carousel images use dark photographic backgrounds, making it look like a missing/placeholder image within the row.
issues.suggestion: Use consistently styled imagery (or apply the same dark overlay/gradient) for all carousel thumbnails so the badges and cards read uniformly.

issues.description: The white '15–25 min' time badge sits on a very light grey thumbnail background, giving low contrast compared with the same badge on the darker adjacent cards.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow, border, or darker scrim behind badges so they remain legible on light imagery.
